critical_code_review_comments: routes/master.py update-check cache: writes settings via _iso() string then parses back — works because both directions use ISO with tz; if MASTER_MODE flag added later, wrap with feature gate.

routes/master.py /status uses count_documents on mail_events with $or on ts/ingested_at — expensive on large collections; add compound index (ts, ingested_at) or precompute a rolling counter to avoid full scan.
routes/master.py /relay/heartbeats sort by last_seen (string ISO) works with UTC 'Z'/'+00:00' but not portable if a client sends different tz suffix — recommend storing as BSON datetime.
routes/maintenance.py /public/blocked-stats iterates up to 50000 mail_events in Python — acceptable now, but consider a Mongo $group aggregation for 100k+ scale.

routes/maintenance.py trust-score/snapshot alert path: alert_fired is only set to True inside try/except of _send_email; if SMTP throws, notifications_inbox is not written and alert_fired stays False (silently). Consider inserting notifications_inbox BEFORE _send_email so the DB record is guaranteed and email is best-effort.
routes/maintenance.py /ip/whitelist doesn't return the created whitelist doc id — minor DX gap for FE if it wants to un-whitelist later without re-querying.
Landing LiveBlockCounter has 'otomatik yenileme · 60sn' badge but review_request says auto-refresh every 5s — verify interval matches spec (visual claim vs behavior).
